content:
We are currently closely monitoring a variety of iPhone 18 Pro accessories, planning to place orders before the cutoff this Friday, as we will be using them ourselves this year. If we had to choose, Apple's AirTag 2 and the all-new AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are absolutely the best matches for the iPhone 18 Pro—along with the world-class Polishing Cloth, which is equally worth buying. But this time we want to go deeper, covering chargers, MagSafe car mounts, phone cases, wallets, and more. We will introduce them one by one below.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance—Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter (up to 60W)
  • Ben—Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael—Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin—Apple iPhone FineWoven MagSafe Wallet
  • Ryan—MagSafe Car Mount (designed specifically for the iPhone 18 Pro)
  • Fernando—Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra-Slim Magnetic Power Bank
  • Simon—Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Charger
  • Justin—Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand
  • Reinette—Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case
  • Other genuinely recommended accessories

If you want to charge your newly purchased iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max in the fastest way possible, you need a compatible charging adapter. Specifically, you need a charger that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply, and Apple's own product is the best choice on the market. It's compact enough, and folds up neatly, able to charge your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max to 50% within 15 minutes.

Apple's TechWoven phone case comes in a variety of deep, rich colour options. It looks great, feels fantastic, the anodised aluminium buttons provide solid tactile feedback, and the entire case is made from 100% recycled polyester yarn—also good for the environment.

Anker's lightweight 3-in-1 wireless charger can power three devices simultaneously through a single portable accessory, with the iPhone charging pad supporting Qi2 wireless charging and MagSafe compatibility. Once folded up, it's compact enough to slip easily into a travel bag—which means you'll never have to drag a tangle of cables and adapters to hotels again—or you can place it on a bedside table or desk, neatly managing your entire Apple ecosystem. It's currently on sale on Amazon at nearly 35% off, an all-time low price.

Apple's FineWoven MagSafe Wallet has always been a must-have accessory for Apple fans who prefer a minimalist style. It can easily hold 3 to 4 cards—whether it's an ID, a few credit cards, or hotel key cards—making it perfect for those who don't want to carry a bulky wallet around every day.

Every time I drive, I want to find a stable and safe place to put my phone. ESR's MagSafe car mount is my top pick. You can securely magnetically attach your iPhone 18 Pro or older models to the mount, which clamps directly onto the air vent for added convenience. This MagSafe car mount not only protects your iPhone but also keeps the screen clearly visible, and charging while driving is completely hassle-free.

I have always believed that a truly practical magnetic power bank that you can carry out with your iPhone every day must be thin enough. Baseus has just released a magnetic power bank that I consider nearly perfect. The Picogo Air is only 0.27 inches thick and weighs just 3.7 ounces. It has a built-in 5,000mAh battery, supports 7.5W wireless charging and 22.5W wired input. The best part is its brand-new burgundy colour, which pairs beautifully with the new iPhone—this is what an ultra-slim magnetic power bank should look like.

If you travel frequently, you will understand that organising your tech bag neatly has already won half the battle. That's why I always keep an eye out for multi-functional charging solutions. Baseus's travel charger is simply perfect—it supports plugs for over 200 countries worldwide, and is designed to charge six devices simultaneously. But for me, the biggest highlight is the built-in 70W retractable USB-C cable, which can fast-charge your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed while steadily powering your iPad, MacBook, and other devices.

Michael previously picked what I think is the most travel-friendly foldable MagSafe charger, but this time I want to focus on my two favourite desktop 3-in-1 models: the Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, whose design is absolutely stunning, with an ultra-minimalist space grey black finish; and the Anker Smart Display 3-in-1, which I also love dearly—but the Satechi is simply too elegant and refined to compare.

After spending a fortune on an iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I usually opt for more affordable accessories rather than splashing out on the most expensive items again. Spigen offers plenty of budget-friendly MagSafe phone cases. My personal favourite is this clear Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case, which is much cheaper than other brands—and there are also opaque multi-colour options, all supporting MagSafe fast wireless charging. These cases inject DuraClear blue resin into the TPU frame to prevent yellowing, paired with shock-absorbing construction; notably, the Camera Control button surface is also wrapped in a thin layer of TPU.

  • AirTag 2
  • Anker 100W USB-C Smart Display Charger
  • Beats Woven USB-C Cable
  • All-new Pitaka Burgundy Aramid Fibre iPhone 18 Pro Protective Case
  • Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Leather Protective Case
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Protective Case
  • Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1
  • Nomad Find My Tracker Card
